items.title: Effects of ankle-foot orthosis-related conditions on muscle activity, spasticity, and psychosocial outcomes after stroke: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 10 studies (931 participants) found that ankle-foot orthosis (AFO)-related conditions were associated with reduced lower-limb EMG activity (SMD = -0.40) and spasticity (SMD = -0.41) after stroke, but showed no significant effect on psychosocial outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述肯定了踝足矫形器（AFO）能有效降低卒中后下肢肌电活动和痉挛，效应量中等。这对你选择康复策略有直接依据，尤其当目标是改善步态稳定性时。
items.titleZh: 踝足矫形器相关条件对卒中后肌肉活动、痉挛和心理社会结局的影响：一项系统综述和 Meta 分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 10 项研究（931 名参与者）的系统综述和 Meta 分析显示，卒中后使用踝足矫形器（AFO）与下肢肌电活动（SMD = -0.40）和痉挛（SMD = -0.41）降低相关，但对心理社会结局无显著影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review confirms that AFOs can effectively reduce lower-limb EMG activity and spasticity post-stroke, with moderate effect sizes. This provides direct evidence for your rehabilitation strategy, especially when aiming to improve gait stability.
items.limitation: 研究未发现踝足矫形器对患者心理社会结局有显著影响，这部分仍待进一步研究。
items.limitationEn: The review found no significant effect of AFOs on psychosocial outcomes, which remains an area for further investigation.

items.title: Exploring the experience of time-restricted eating in veterans with spinal cord injury and obesity: a qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study explored the experiences of 14 veterans with spinal cord injury (SCI) and obesity participating in time-restricted eating (TRE), identifying motives, participation experiences, perceived health changes, and unique barriers and facilitators such as medication management and routine consistency.
items.curatedReason: 如果你手上有 SCI 合并肥胖的患者想尝试限时进食 (TRE)，这项研究提示，他们可能会面临药物和排便管理等独特挑战，以及对规律作息的高度依赖。虽然是小样本定性研究，但它为这类患者提供了初步的用户视角，值得我们在临床实践中予以关注。
items.titleZh: 探究脊髓损伤合并肥胖退伍军人限时进食体验的定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究探讨了 14 名脊髓损伤 (SCI) 合并肥胖的退伍军人参与限时进食 (TRE) 的体验，识别了其动机、参与体验、感知到的健康变化，以及独特的障碍（如药物管理）和促进因素（如规律作息）。
items.curatedReasonEn: For patients with SCI and obesity considering time-restricted eating (TRE), this study suggests they may encounter unique challenges like medication and bowel management, and a strong reliance on consistent routines. While a small qualitative study, it offers an initial patient perspective on TRE in this population, which clinicians should note.
items.limitation: 这是一项小样本定性研究，结果的普适性有限，且可能存在回忆偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This is a small-sample qualitative study with limited generalizability, and potential for recall bias.

items.title: A Valid and Reliable Virtual Reality Tool for Assessment of Arm Nonuse Post-Stroke
items.summary: A novel virtual reality (VR-NonUse) tool demonstrated reliability, validity, and usability in assessing paretic arm nonuse in 51 individuals post-stroke, showing stronger associations with established nonuse measures than with motor impairment.
items.curatedReason: 针对卒中后偏瘫手臂非使用，这项研究提示我们，新的 VR-NonUse 工具在评估信效度上表现良好。它能更好地反映“非使用”本身，而非单纯的运动障碍，这有助于你区分纯运动受限和患者刻意不使用手臂的情况。
items.titleZh: 一种有效且可靠的虚拟现实工具，用于评估卒中后手臂非使用
items.summaryZh: 一项新颖的虚拟现实（VR-NonUse）工具在评估 51 名卒中后患者患侧手臂非使用方面表现出良好的可靠性、有效性和可用性，与现有非使用评估工具的相关性更强。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests a new VR-NonUse tool shows promising reliability and validity for assessing paretic arm nonuse post-stroke. Importantly, it correlates more strongly with established nonuse measures than with motor impairment, helping you differentiate between true motor deficits and learned nonuse.
items.limitation: 这是一项探索性验证研究，需在更大范围和多样化人群中进一步验证其长期预测价值和对治疗干预的指导作用。
items.limitationEn: This is an exploratory validation study, and its long-term predictive value and guidance for therapeutic interventions need further validation in larger, more diverse populations.

items.title: Feasibility and efficacy of personalized cardiorespiratory and strength exercise in Duchenne muscular dystrophy: a pilot study
items.summary: A pilot study with six ambulatory boys with Duchenne muscular dystrophy showed personalized home-based, remotely-supervised leg cycling and isometric strengthening was feasible and safe over 6 months, improving peak VO2 and submaximal-cycling HR, and increasing CSA relative to controls.
items.curatedReason: DMD 患者的个性化有氧与力量训练是安全且可行的。这项初步研究提示，早期、定制化的干预能改善心肺功能和肌肉质量，支持将其作为常规治疗的补充手段。
items.titleZh: 杜氏肌营养不良症患者个性化心肺和力量训练的可行性与有效性：一项初步研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对六名可步行杜氏肌营养不良症男孩的初步研究显示，为期 6 个月的个性化居家远程监督下肢骑行和等长力量训练安全可行，可改善峰值摄氧量和次最大运动心率，并相对于对照组增加肌肉横截面积。
items.curatedReasonEn: Personalized cardiorespiratory and strength training is safe and feasible for DMD patients. This pilot study suggests that early, tailored interventions can improve cardiorespiratory fitness and muscle mass, supporting its role as a complementary therapeutic strategy.
items.limitation: 这是一项小样本的初步可行性研究，所有数据来自六名受试者，尚需大规模RCT验证长期疗效。
items.limitationEn: This is a small-sample pilot feasibility study, with data from only six participants; large-scale RCTs are needed to validate long-term efficacy.

items.title: Therapists' perspectives on the use of an overground lower-limb exoskeleton in physiotherapy sessions for minimally ambulatory children with cerebral palsy: a qualitative study
items.summary: A qualitative study explored therapists' perspectives on using an overground lower-limb exoskeleton for minimally ambulatory children with cerebral palsy, finding it a valuable adjunct to conventional therapy but requiring new skills and resources, and highlighting considerations for clinical implementation.
items.curatedReason: 对于重度脑瘫儿童，下肢外骨骼训练被视为常规物理治疗的有益补充，而非替代。了解治疗师的使用体验和面临的资源挑战，有助于诊所评估其潜在价值和实际操作问题。
items.titleZh: 治疗师视角下的地面前行下肢外骨骼在微步行脑瘫儿童物理治疗中的应用：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究探讨了治疗师对在微步行脑瘫儿童物理治疗中使用地面前行下肢外骨骼的看法，发现其是常规治疗的宝贵辅助手段，但需要新技能和资源，并强调了临床实施中的考量因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: For minimally ambulatory children with cerebral palsy, lower-limb exoskeleton training is viewed as a beneficial adjunct to conventional physical therapy, not a replacement. Understanding therapists' experiences and resource challenges helps clinics assess its potential value and practical implementation issues.
items.limitation: 这是一项定性研究，样本量小且基于治疗师的感知，结果可能不具备广泛代表性，且未直接评估患儿的临床结局改善。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative study with a small sample size based on therapists' perceptions; results may not be broadly representative and did not directly assess clinical outcome improvements in children.

items.title: Proprioception Training and Surrogate Outcomes: A Systematic Review of Definitions, Measures, and Effectiveness Claims.
items.summary: A systematic review of 51 randomized controlled trials (n=2319) found that while multimodal regimens often improved surrogate outcomes (balance, pain, strength), direct psychophysical proprioceptive function was consistently enhanced only when training explicitly targeted the measured sensory construct. Improvements inferred from surrogate outcomes were more frequent and often larger than those in direct psychophysical measures.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述明确指出，要真正改善本体感觉，训练必须直接针对特定的感觉结构，而不是依赖平衡、力量或疼痛等替代指标。这促使你重新审视本体感觉训练方案，优先选择心理物理学结局验证过的干预。
items.titleZh: 本体感觉训练与替代结局：一项关于定义、测量和有效性声明的系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对 51 项随机对照试验（n=2319）的系统综述发现，尽管多模式方案通常能改善替代结局（平衡、疼痛、力量），但只有当训练明确针对所测量的感觉结构时，直接的心理物理学本体感觉功能才能得到持续增强。从替代结局推断的改善比直接心理物理学测量观察到的改善更频繁且幅度更大。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review clarifies that to truly improve proprioception, training must directly target specific sensory constructs, rather than relying on surrogate outcomes like balance, strength, or pain. This should prompt you to re-evaluate proprioceptive training protocols, prioritizing interventions validated by psychophysical outcomes.
items.limitation: 纳入的 RCT 在本体感觉的定义、测量方法和效果声明上存在异质性，可能影响结果的综合解释。
items.limitationEn: The included RCTs exhibited heterogeneity in proprioception definitions, measurement approaches, and effectiveness claims, potentially affecting the synthesis and interpretation of results.

items.title: Clinical sensory tests in professional practice: a web-based survey on awareness and challenges among Italian physicians and physiotherapists.
items.summary: A cross-sectional web-based survey of 496 Italian physicians and physiotherapists (105 physicians, 391 physiotherapists) found that time constraints were the most common barrier to clinical sensory testing (85.7% of physicians, 77.2% of physiotherapists). Respondents generally perceived clinical sensory testing as low-cost and useful.
items.curatedReason: 这项意大利的调查揭示了物理治疗师和医师在临床感觉测试中使用和认知上的异同。作为 PT，你可能会发现，时间限制和对小纤维评估的重视，与意大利同行有共鸣。
items.titleZh: 意大利医师和物理治疗师对临床感觉测试的认知与挑战：一项网络调查
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 496 名意大利医师和物理治疗师（105 名医师，391 名物理治疗师）的横断面网络调查发现，时间限制是临床感觉测试最常见的障碍（85.7% 的医师，77.2% 的物理治疗师）。受访者普遍认为临床感觉测试成本低廉且实用。
items.curatedReasonEn: This Italian survey highlights similarities and differences in the use and perception of clinical sensory testing between physiotherapists and physicians. As a PT, you may find common ground with Italian colleagues regarding time constraints and the importance placed on small-fiber assessment.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面网络调查，结果基于自我报告，不能代表全国性估计，也无法反映客观知识、专业能力或实际使用情况。
items.limitationEn: This cross-sectional web-based survey relies on self-reported perceptions and is not nationally representative, nor does it reflect objective knowledge, verified competence, or actual use.

items.title: Cost-utility of non-pharmacologic interventions aimed at improving cognitive outcomes after traumatic brain injury in older adulthood from the Ontario public healthcare payer perspective
items.summary: A cost-utility analysis in Ontario, Canada, comparing non-pharmacologic interventions for older adults (≥ 65 years) post-TBI, found that combination therapy (physical rehabilitation and cognitive training) yielded the highest QALYs (3.04 QALYs) and net monetary benefit (CAD$102,653), with an ICER of CAD$18,028 per QALY gained.
items.curatedReason: 这项成本效益分析明确指出，在加拿大安大略省的公共医疗体系下，针对老年创伤性脑损伤（TBI）患者，结合物理康复和认知训练的干预措施最具成本效益，显著提高了 QALYs 并降低了痴呆发生率。这意味着在资源有限的环境中，组合疗法应成为你优化 TBI 老年患者认知结局的首选策略。
items.titleZh: 从安大略省公共医疗支付方视角看，旨在改善老年创伤性脑损伤后认知结局的非药物干预措施的成本效益
items.summaryZh: 一项在加拿大安大略省进行的成本效益分析显示，针对老年（≥ 65 岁）TBI 患者的非药物干预中，结合物理康复和认知训练的组合疗法产生了最高的质量调整生命年（3.04 QALYs）和净货币收益（CAD$102,653），增量成本效益比为 CAD$18,028/QALY。
items.curatedReasonEn: This cost-utility analysis clearly indicates that for older adults with traumatic brain injury (TBI) within Ontario, Canada's public healthcare system, combined physical rehabilitation and cognitive training is the most cost-effective intervention, significantly improving QALYs and reducing dementia incidence. This means that in resource-constrained settings, combination therapy should be your preferred strategy for optimizing cognitive outcomes in older TBI patients.
items.limitation: 该研究的成本效益分析结果特定于加拿大安大略省的公共医疗支付方视角，其经济参数和阈值可能不适用于其他医疗系统。
items.limitationEn: The cost-utility analysis results are specific to the Ontario public healthcare payer perspective, and its economic parameters and thresholds may not be applicable to other healthcare systems.

items.title: Exercise snacking as a novel strategy for prevention and intervention of frailty in older adults: a scoping review
items.summary: A scoping review on "exercise snacking" as a novel strategy for preventing and intervening in frailty in older adults found promising potential, particularly given the unsuitability of conventional long-duration exercise for this population.
items.curatedReason: 这项范围综述表明，对老年人来说，将零星运动（exercise snacking）作为预防和干预衰弱的新策略是可行的。考虑到传统长时间运动对老年人的挑战，你应该开始探索如何将这种短时、高频的运动模式融入你的老年患者康复方案，以提高依从性和效果。
items.titleZh: 零星运动作为预防和干预老年人衰弱的新策略：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项关于“零星运动”作为预防和干预老年人衰弱新策略的范围综述发现其具有广阔潜力，尤其考虑到传统长时间运动对老年人往往不适用。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review suggests that 'exercise snacking' is a viable new strategy for frailty prevention and intervention in older adults. Given the challenges older adults face with traditional long-duration exercise, you should explore integrating these short, frequent bursts of activity into your geriatric rehabilitation programs to improve adherence and outcomes.
items.limitation: 该范围综述主要基于对中年和青年人的研究，专门针对老年衰弱的证据仍然缺乏，需要更多老年人群的直接研究。
items.limitationEn: This scoping review is largely based on studies in middle-aged and young adults, with direct evidence specifically addressing frailty in older adults still lacking, necessitating more direct research in this population.

items.title: Centering First Nations parents' voices: a community-directed pediatric rehabilitation needs assessment in Northern Saskatchewan.
items.summary: A community-based participatory action research study in Northern Saskatchewan found that First Nations parents face significant barriers in accessing pediatric rehabilitation services due to an inequitable healthcare system, recommending a shift towards strength-based, family-centered, culturally grounded, and community-led care.
items.curatedReason: 这项社区导向的研究揭示了加拿大原住民儿童康复服务中存在的严重系统性不平等，包括信息匮乏、服务延迟和资源不足。这要求我们重新审视现有评估框架，转向以家庭为中心、文化为基础的康复模式，避免沿用西方医学模式的偏见。
items.titleZh: 以原住民父母之声为中心：萨斯喀彻温省北部社区导向的儿童康复需求评估
items.summaryZh: 一项加拿大萨斯喀彻温省北部社区参与式行动研究发现，原住民父母因医疗系统不平等，在获取儿科康复服务方面面临重大障碍，建议转向以优势为基础、家庭为中心、文化为根基、社区主导的护理模式。
items.curatedReasonEn: This community-directed study highlights severe systemic inequities in pediatric rehabilitation services for Indigenous children in Northern Saskatchewan, including lack of information, service delays, and insufficient resources. It mandates a critical re-evaluation of existing frameworks towards family-centered, culturally grounded rehabilitation, moving away from biases inherent in Western medical models.
items.limitation: 该研究基于定性访谈，未量化服务差距，且结果特异于加拿大北部原住民社区，推广性有限。
items.limitationEn: This study is based on qualitative interviews, does not quantify service gaps, and its findings are specific to Northern Saskatchewan Indigenous communities, limiting generalizability.

items.title: Comparative changes in cardiovascular measures following speed, agility, and quickness training and small-sided games in youth football players: a randomized trial
items.summary: A randomized trial compared the cardiovascular measures following speed, agility, and quickness (SAQ) training and small-sided games (SSGs) in youth football players, investigating their differential physical and football-specific demands.
items.curatedReason: 对于青少年足球运动员，这项研究证实 SAQ 训练和小型比赛（SSG）在心血管负荷上存在差异。这意味着在设计体能和康复计划时，应根据训练目标更精细地选择 SAQ 或 SSG，以实现特定的生理适应。
items.titleZh: 青少年足球运动员速度、敏捷性、快速性训练与小型比赛后心血管指标的比较性变化：一项随机试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机试验比较了青少年足球运动员在速度、敏捷性、快速性（SAQ）训练和小型比赛（SSGs）后心血管指标的变化，旨在研究它们在身体和足球特定需求上的差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: For youth football players, this RCT confirms distinct cardiovascular loads between SAQ training and small-sided games (SSG). When designing conditioning or rehab programs, you should meticulously choose between SAQ and SSG based on your specific training objectives to elicit desired physiological adaptations.
items.limitation: 摘要未提供具体的关键效应量或统计数据，仅提及比较性变化，限制了对其临床意义的解读。
items.limitationEn: The abstract does not provide specific key effect sizes or statistical data, only mentioning comparative changes, which limits the interpretation of its clinical significance.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Biological effects of technique-specific manual therapy in healthy individuals and people with musculoskeletal disorders: a systematic review with meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 50 studies (2,147 participants) found that manual therapy induces short-term neurophysiological modulation with technique-specific responses. Joint mobilization significantly increased skin conductance (sympathetic marker) versus sham in healthy cohorts, while non-HVLA soft tissue techniques were associated with reduced heart rate and increased RMSSD (parasympathetic marker).
items.curatedReason: 手法治疗确实能即刻影响神经生理，但要分清楚：关节松动术主要激活交感神经（皮肤电导增加），而软组织技术则更倾向于激活副交感神经（心率降低，RMSSD 增加）。所以，别再把所有手法一概而论了，你的技术选择应与你希望引发的自主神经反应相匹配。
items.titleZh: 技术特异性手法治疗对健康个体和肌肉骨骼疾病患者的生物学效应：一项系统综述与 Meta 分析
items.summaryZh: 一项涵盖 50 项研究（2,147 名参与者）的系统综述和 Meta 分析发现，手法治疗能够短期调节神经生理反应，且存在技术特异性效应。在健康人群中，关节松动术显著增加了皮肤电导（交感神经标志物），而非高低速（non-HVLA）软组织技术则与心率降低和 RMSSD 升高（副交感神经标志物）相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: Manual therapy does induce immediate neurophysiological changes, but specific techniques matter: joint mobilization primarily elicits sympathetic responses (increased skin conductance), while non-HVLA soft tissue techniques lean towards parasympathetic activation (reduced heart rate, increased RMSSD). Stop lumping all manual therapies together; align your technique choice with your desired autonomic nervous system response.
items.limitation: 证据确定性为低到中等，主要由于方法学异质性和不精确性。
items.limitationEn: The certainty of evidence ranged from low to moderate, mainly due to methodological heterogeneity and imprecision.
items.journal: The Journal of manual & manipulative therapy

items.title: Reframing patient expectations as therapeutic targets in musculoskeletal care.
items.summary: This Professional Practice article argues that patient expectations (PEs) are modifiable, therapeutic targets, extending beyond treatment to relational, contextual, lifestyle, spiritual, and cultural dimensions. Reconceptualizing PEs as dynamic and co-created, physiotherapists can deliver person-centered care by systematically assessing and aligning PEs with prognosis through shared decision-making.
items.curatedReason: 这篇述评强调，患者期望不仅是预后因素，更是可主动干预的治疗靶点。评估患者期望并将其融入沟通和共享决策，能够增强治疗联盟并改善长期结局。
items.titleZh: 将患者期望重新定义为肌肉骨骼护理中的治疗靶点
items.summaryZh: 这篇专业实践文章指出，患者期望（PEs）不仅是预后因素，更是可主动干预的治疗靶点，其影响超越治疗本身，涵盖关系、情境、生活方式、精神和文化层面。物理治疗师通过系统评估并结合共享决策，能将动态和共同构建的PEs融入个性化护理，从而加强治疗联盟并改善长期结局。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary highlights that patient expectations are not just prognostic indicators but modifiable therapeutic targets. Systematically assessing and integrating patient expectations into communication and shared decision-making can enhance the therapeutic alliance and improve long-term outcomes.

items.title: Impact of Social Determinants of Health on Physical Therapy Utilization in Home Health and Outpatient Settings: A Retrospective Cohort Study.
items.summary: A cross-sectional study of 74,937 Medicare beneficiaries found that social determinants of health (SDOH) at patient, hospital, and regional levels influenced home health and outpatient physical therapy utilization after lower extremity joint replacement. Black patients had more visits, while dual-eligibility status was associated with more home health but fewer outpatient visits. Greater socioeconomic vulnerability was linked to more home health and outpatient visits.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究揭示了美国 Medicare 患者在下肢关节置换术后接受居家和门诊物理治疗时，社会健康决定因素（SDOH）对其利用率的影响。规划出院时考虑 SDOH，有助于促进公平的康复服务可及性。
items.titleZh: 社会健康决定因素对居家和门诊物理治疗利用率的影响：一项回顾性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项涵盖 74,937 名 Medicare 受益人的横断面研究发现，患者、医院和区域层面的社会健康决定因素（SDOH）会影响下肢关节置换术后居家和门诊物理治疗的利用率。其中，非裔患者的就诊次数更多，双重医保资格患者的居家治疗次数更多但门诊治疗次数更少。社会经济脆弱性更高与居家和门诊治疗的更多利用率相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study reveals the impact of social determinants of health (SDOH) on the utilization of home health and outpatient physical therapy after lower extremity joint replacement among US Medicare patients. Considering SDOH during discharge planning can help promote equitable access to rehabilitation services.
items.limitation: 研究设计为回顾性横断面，基于 Medicare 医保数据，存在数据局限性和潜在的混杂因素。
items.limitationEn: The study's retrospective cross-sectional design, relying on Medicare claims data, has data limitations and potential confounding factors.

items.title: Developing biopsychosocial competence in musculoskeletal pain care: Australian physiotherapy educators' perspectives.
items.summary: A qualitative study with 18 Australian physiotherapy educators identified five themes, or 'translation levers,' crucial for developing biopsychosocial competence and facilitating its clinical adoption in musculoskeletal pain care.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究深入探讨了澳大利亚物理治疗教育者如何教授生物心理社会模型，识别出支持该模型临床转化的具体工具、结构和流程。这为你理解和改进教学策略提供了实践框架。
items.titleZh: 培养肌肉骨骼疼痛护理中的生物心理社会能力：澳大利亚物理治疗教育者的视角
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 18 名澳大利亚物理治疗教育者的定性研究确定了五个主题，即“转化杠杆”，这些主题对于培养生物心理社会能力并促进其在肌肉骨骼疼痛护理中的临床应用至关重要。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study explores how Australian physiotherapy educators teach the biopsychosocial model, identifying specific tools, structures, and processes that support its clinical translation. It offers a practical framework for understanding and improving your teaching strategies.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性探索性研究，样本量小且局限于澳大利亚教育者的视角，其发现的转化杠杆需要在更广泛的背景下进行验证。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative exploratory study has a small sample size and is limited to the perspectives of Australian educators, meaning the identified translation levers require validation in broader contexts.

items.title: The Impact of Upper Extremity Rehabilitation on Fatigue in Individuals With Multiple Sclerosis: A Systematic Review.
items.summary: A systematic review of nine studies (n=250) on upper extremity rehabilitation for fatigue in PwMS found insufficient evidence to draw definitive conclusions, with low to very low certainty of evidence.
items.curatedReason: 该系统综述表明，当前关于上肢康复对多发性硬化症患者疲劳影响的证据仍然不足，尽管研究了多种技术辅助和运动干预。在缺乏高质量证据的情况下，不要将上肢康复作为减轻疲劳的独立干预措施。
items.titleZh: 上肢康复对多发性硬化症患者疲劳影响的系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项针对多发性硬化症患者疲劳上肢康复的九项研究（n=250）的系统综述发现，现有证据不足以得出明确结论，且证据确定性为低至非常低。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review indicates that current evidence on the effects of upper extremity rehabilitation on fatigue in PwMS is insufficient, despite various technology-assisted and exercise-based interventions. Avoid positioning upper extremity rehabilitation as a standalone intervention for fatigue given the lack of high-quality evidence.
items.limitation: 纳入研究的证据确定性低至非常低，且异质性高，限制了得出明确结论的能力。
items.limitationEn: The included studies exhibit low to very low certainty of evidence and high heterogeneity, limiting the ability to draw definitive conclusions.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: The Effect of Robot-Assisted Gait Training on Balance, Gait and Kinesiophobia in Individuals With Post-Stroke Hemiparesis: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A single-blind, parallel-group RCT (n=60) found that adding robot-assisted gait training (RAGT) to conventional rehabilitation significantly improved balance, gait, walking speed, balance confidence, and kinesiophobia in individuals with post-stroke hemiparesis, with a between-group difference in KCS total score of -0.36 (95% CI: -0.51 to -0.21).
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 证明，在常规康复中加入机器人辅助步态训练（RAGT）能显著改善卒中后偏瘫患者的平衡、步态、步行速度以及运动恐惧症。这些发现支持了 RAGT 的附加益处，但在比较干预效果时，请记住总治疗暴露量增加的局限性。
items.titleZh: 机器人辅助步态训练对卒中后偏瘫患者平衡、步态和运动恐惧症的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项单盲、平行组随机对照试验（n=60）发现，在常规康复中加入机器人辅助步态训练（RAGT）能显著改善卒中后偏瘫患者的平衡、步态、步行速度、平衡信心和运动恐惧症，KCS 总分组间差异为 -0.36（95% CI：-0.51 至 -0.21）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT demonstrates that adding robot-assisted gait training (RAGT) to conventional rehabilitation significantly improves balance, gait, walking speed, and kinesiophobia in individuals with post-stroke hemiparesis. These findings support the additional benefits of RAGT, but remember the limitation of increased overall treatment exposure when comparing intervention effects.
items.limitation: 研究观察到的组间差异可能部分归因于 RAGT 组获得了更大的总体治疗暴露量，而不仅仅是机器人组件本身的效果。
items.limitationEn: Observed between-group differences may be partially attributable to the RAGT group receiving greater overall treatment exposure, not solely the robotic component.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Manual Lymph Drainage in Lower Extremity Lymphedema Management: An Essential Component or An Optional Extra? A Single-Blind, Randomized Non-Inferiority Trial
items.summary: This single-blind, randomized non-inferiority trial aims to determine if compression bandaging alone is non-inferior to compression bandaging combined with manual lymphatic drainage for reducing limb volume, tissue stiffness, and skin/subcutaneous thickness in Stage 2–3 lower extremity lymphedema.
items.curatedReason: 这项非劣效性试验旨在评估单独使用加压包扎是否不劣于结合手工淋巴引流（MLD）的治疗。其结果将直接影响你在一期和二期下肢淋巴水肿治疗中 MLD 的常规使用，判断其是否为核心要素。
items.titleZh: 下肢淋巴水肿管理中的手工淋巴引流：核心组成部分还是可选附加项？一项单盲、随机非劣效性试验
items.summaryZh: 这项单盲、随机非劣效性试验旨在确定单独使用加压包扎在减少二期至三期下肢淋巴水肿（LEL）的肢体体积、组织硬度和皮肤/皮下厚度方面，是否不劣于结合手工淋巴引流（MLD）的加压包扎。
items.curatedReasonEn: This non-inferiority trial aims to assess whether compression bandaging alone is non-inferior to CB combined with MLD. Its results will directly impact your routine use of MLD in intensive phase treatment for Stage 2-3 lower extremity lymphedema, determining if it is an essential component.
items.limitation: 由于这是对非劣效性的评估，研究结果的临床意义将取决于设定的非劣效性界值是否足够小以反映实际临床差异。
items.limitationEn: As this is an assessment of non-inferiority, the clinical relevance of the results will depend on whether the set non-inferiority margin is sufficiently small to reflect a true clinical difference.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Comparison of action observation therapy and virtual reality combined with conventional therapy for upper extremity rehabilitation in children with unilateral cerebral palsy.
items.summary: This RCT (n=45) found that both action observation therapy and virtual reality (XBOX Kinect) combined with conventional physiotherapy improved upper extremity function and participation more than conventional therapy alone in children with unilateral cerebral palsy.
items.curatedReason: 对于单侧脑瘫儿童的上肢康复，动作观察疗法（AOT）和虚拟现实（XBOX）均显示出优于传统疗法的效果。在考虑辅助治疗方案时，可以纳入这两种方法，尤其是在精细抓握和选择性控制方面，AOT 可能提供更全面的改善。
items.titleZh: 动作观察疗法与虚拟现实结合常规疗法在单侧脑瘫儿童上肢康复中的比较
items.summaryZh: 这项随机对照试验（n=45）发现，在单侧脑瘫儿童的上肢康复中，动作观察疗法和虚拟现实（XBOX Kinect）结合常规物理治疗，在改善上肢功能和参与度方面均优于单纯的常规治疗。
items.curatedReasonEn: For upper extremity rehabilitation in children with unilateral cerebral palsy, both action observation therapy (AOT) and virtual reality (XBOX) showed superior effects compared to conventional therapy. When considering supplementary treatment options, these two methods can be included, with AOT potentially offering more comprehensive improvements, especially in fine grasp and selective control.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（n=45），随访时间较短（3周）。
items.limitationEn: The study had a small sample size (n=45) and a short follow-up period (3 weeks).

items.title: Scar dry needling for tissue compliance in individuals with linear scars: a randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: This RCT (n=80) compared scar dry needling (DN) with minimal needling, finding that scar-DN was associated with short-term improvements in tissue compliance at some indentation depths, but no significant differences in local scar-related pain or health-related quality of life.
items.curatedReason: 干针在疤痕管理中的证据尚有限，但这项研究提示它能在短期内改善线性疤痕的组织柔顺性。虽然疼痛和生活质量未见显著改善，但组织力学变化本身值得我们继续关注其长期临床价值和适用边界。
items.titleZh: 线性疤痕个体干针治疗对组织柔顺性的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 这项随机对照试验（n=80）比较了疤痕干针（DN）与微量针刺，发现疤痕干针在某些压痕深度上与短期组织柔顺性改善相关，但在局部疤痕相关疼痛或健康相关生活质量方面未见显著差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: Evidence for dry needling in scar management is limited, but this study suggests it can improve tissue compliance in linear scars short-term. While no significant improvements in pain or quality of life were observed, the mechanical changes in tissue warrant continued attention to its long-term clinical value and application boundaries.
items.limitation: 研究未能发现干针在疤痕相关疼痛或健康相关生活质量方面的显著改善，且部分分析（如被动膝关节屈曲）样本量过小，限制了结论的外推性。
items.limitationEn: The study did not find significant improvements in scar-related pain or health-related quality of life with dry needling, and some analyses (e.g., passive knee flexion) had very small sample sizes, limiting the generalizability of conclusions.
items.journal: The Journal of manual & manipulative therapy

items.title: Effects of a Cycling-Based Aerobic Exercise Program Versus a Resistance and Neuromuscular Exercise Program on Exercise-Induced Hypoalgesia in Knee Osteoarthritis: A Study Protocol for a Randomized Clinical Trial.
items.summary: This study protocol outlines a randomized controlled trial (n=90) to compare the effects of a cycling-based aerobic exercise program versus a resistance and neuromuscular exercise program on exercise-induced hypoalgesia (EIH) in individuals with knee osteoarthritis.
items.curatedReason: 这是一项研究方案，并非实际结果，所以现在改变你的临床实践还为时过早。但如果这项纳入 90 人的 RCT 最终显示，骑行或其他有氧运动在改善膝骨关节炎患者运动诱发痛觉减退（EIH）方面优于传统阻抗和神经肌肉训练，那么它将挑战我们目前对运动处方的固有认知。
items.titleZh: 循环式有氧运动与抗阻及神经肌肉运动对膝骨关节炎患者运动诱发痛觉减退影响的研究方案：一项随机临床试验
items.summaryZh: 这项研究方案描述了一项随机对照试验（n=90），旨在比较循环式有氧运动方案与抗阻及神经肌肉运动方案对膝骨关节炎患者运动诱发痛觉减退（EIH）的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: This is a study protocol, not actual results, so it's premature to change your clinical practice. However, if this n=90 RCT ultimately demonstrates that cycling or other aerobic exercise is superior to traditional resistance and neuromuscular training in improving exercise-induced hypoalgesia (EIH) in knee OA patients, it will challenge our current understanding of exercise prescription.
items.limitation: 这是一项研究方案，尚未有实际结果。
items.limitationEn: This is a study protocol, and actual results are not yet available.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Gait Speed Changes in Stroke Rehabilitation Motor Lower Extremity Randomized Controlled Trials by Intervention and Time Post-Stroke: A Meta-Analysis.
items.summary: A meta-analysis of 106 RCTs found that motor lower extremity stroke rehabilitation interventions in the acute/subacute phases demonstrated significantly greater magnitude of improvement in gait speed compared to those in the chronic phase, with treadmill training, body weight-supported treadmill training, and exoskeletons showing significant benefits acutely.
items.curatedReason: 卒中后下肢运动康复，请务必在急性/亚急性期介入，因为对步速改善的效应量远大于慢性期。其中，跑步机训练、体位支持跑步机训练和外骨骼在急性期都有显著益处。
items.titleZh: 卒中康复下肢运动随机对照试验中步速变化：干预手段与卒中后时间的荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项涵盖106项随机对照试验的荟萃分析发现，卒中后下肢运动康复干预在急性/亚急性期对步速改善的效应量显著大于慢性期，其中跑步机训练、体位支持跑步机训练和外骨骼在急性期显示出显著益处。
items.curatedReasonEn: For post-stroke lower extremity motor rehabilitation, prioritize intervention in the acute/subacute phases, as the effect size for gait speed improvement is significantly greater than in the chronic phase. Treadmill training, body weight-supported treadmill training, and exoskeletons all show significant benefits acutely.
items.limitation: 尽管分析涵盖了大量RCT，但不同干预措施在研究方法、患者异质性及结果测量上的差异，可能影响了荟萃分析的总体解释力。
items.limitationEn: Although the analysis included a large number of RCTs, variations in research methods, patient heterogeneity, and outcome measures across different interventions may affect the overall interpretability of the meta-analysis.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Effects of Virtual Reality-Assisted Task-Oriented Training on Clinical and Psychosocial Outcomes in Individuals with Rotator Cuff Tears: A Randomized Controlled Single-Blind Trial.
items.summary: Adding virtual reality-assisted task-oriented training (VR-TOT) to conventional physiotherapy in individuals with partial rotator cuff tears significantly improved upper extremity function (DASH mean difference -3.93 points), pain, shoulder-related disability, kinesiophobia, and pain catastrophizing in the short term, though the DASH difference did not reach MCID.
items.curatedReason: 本研究提示，对于部分肩袖撕裂，常规物理治疗中加入虚拟现实辅助任务导向训练，可在短期内进一步改善上肢功能、疼痛和运动恐惧，但功能改善的效应量未达临床最小重要差异。
items.titleZh: 虚拟现实辅助任务导向训练对肩袖撕裂患者临床与心理社会结局的影响：一项随机对照单盲试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照单盲试验显示，对于部分肩袖撕裂患者，在常规物理治疗中加入虚拟现实辅助任务导向训练，可显著改善上肢功能（DASH 平均差异 -3.93 点）、疼痛、肩关节相关残疾、运动恐惧和疼痛灾难化，但DASH的改善量未达到临床最小重要差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests that adding virtual reality-assisted task-oriented training to conventional physiotherapy for partial rotator cuff tears can further improve upper extremity function, pain, and kinesiophobia in the short term. However, the effect size for functional improvement did not reach the minimally clinically important difference.
items.limitation: 该研究的DASH功能改善虽具统计学意义，但未达到已发表的临床最小重要差异（MCID），且随访期较短。
items.limitationEn: Although statistically significant, the improvement in DASH scores in this study did not reach the published Minimally Clinically Important Difference (MCID), and the follow-up period was short.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: The effects of robot assisted therapy on upper limb functions and gait parameters in cerebral palsy: A randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: This randomized controlled trial found that adding upper extremity robotic-assisted training to conventional physiotherapy in children with cerebral palsy significantly improved various upper limb outcomes, including wrist flexion (mean change 10.37° vs 1.13°), forearm supination (median change 17.5° vs 2.0°), and Jebsen-Taylor Hand Function Test time (mean change -37.67 s vs -9.30 s), and positively influenced gait parameters like unaffected stance phase.
items.curatedReason: 这项RCT提示，对脑瘫患儿，在常规物理治疗中加入上肢机器人辅助训练，不仅能改善上肢功能，还能对步态参数产生积极影响。这意味着上肢机器人干预可能带来超越单一肢体训练的全身性益处，值得在临床中探索其潜力。
items.titleZh: 机器人辅助疗法对脑瘫患者上肢功能和步态参数的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验发现，在脑瘫患儿的常规物理治疗中加入上肢机器人辅助训练，可显著改善多项上肢结局，包括腕关节屈曲（平均变化 10.37° 对 1.13°）、前臂旋后（中位变化 17.5° 对 2.0°）和 Jebsen-Taylor 手功能测试时间（平均变化 -37.67 秒 对 -9.30 秒），并对步态参数如非受累侧站立相产生积极影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT suggests that adding upper extremity robot-assisted training to conventional physiotherapy for children with cerebral palsy can improve upper extremity function and positively influence gait parameters. This implies that upper extremity robotic intervention may offer systemic benefits beyond single-limb training, warranting exploration of its potential in clinical practice.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（31名），且干预时间（6周）和随访期较短，可能限制了结论的长期稳定性和外推性。
items.limitationEn: The study had a small sample size (31 participants) and a short intervention (6 weeks) and follow-up period, which may limit the long-term stability and generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Effectiveness of photobiomodulation therapy associated with multimodal therapeutic intervention program versus multimodal therapeutic intervention program in chronic non-specific neck pain: A randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: This randomized controlled trial found that adding photobiomodulation therapy (PBMT) to a multimodal therapeutic intervention program (MTIP) did not yield further improvements in functional disability (NDI difference 4.06 post-intervention) or pain intensity (resting pain difference 0.54 post-intervention) compared to MTIP alone in individuals with chronic nonspecific neck pain.
items.curatedReason: 对于慢性非特异性颈痛，这项研究提示光生物调节疗法（PBMT）联合多模式治疗方案，并不能比单独的多模式治疗带来额外的好处，在临床决策中应注意其增益有限。
items.titleZh: 慢性非特异性颈痛中，光生物调节疗法联合多模式治疗方案与单独多模式治疗方案的疗效对比：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验显示，对于慢性非特异性颈痛患者，在多模式治疗方案（MTIP）中加入光生物调节疗法（PBMT），并未在功能残疾（NDI 治疗后差异 4.06）或疼痛强度（静息疼痛治疗后差异 0.54）方面比单独MTIP带来额外改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: For chronic nonspecific neck pain, this study suggests that photobiomodulation therapy (PBMT) combined with a multimodal therapeutic intervention program does not offer additional benefits compared to the multimodal program alone. Clinicians should note its limited incremental gain in decision-making.
items.limitation: 研究排除了有神经压迫或放射痛的颈痛患者，且PBMT的剂量条件特定，可能限制了结果对更广泛人群和不同治疗方案的普适性。
items.limitationEn: The study excluded patients with cervical radiculopathy or radiating pain, and the specific PBMT dosage conditions may limit the generalizability of the results to a broader population and different treatment protocols.

items.title: Paired comparison of extrinsic feedback effects on motor learning and functional recovery after stroke: a secondary analysis of randomized controlled trials.
items.summary: A secondary analysis of five RCTs (n=149) found that extrinsic feedback significantly improved motor learning (SMD 1.19; 95% CI 0.16-2.22) in stroke survivors, but effects on functional recovery were not significant (SMD 1.00; 95% CI -0.42-2.42), with no statistical difference between the two outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 外源性反馈能增强卒中后的任务特异性运动学习（SMD 1.19），但这些学习收益不一定能转化为功能恢复。这意味着在设计康复干预和评估效果时，你不能仅关注任务表现，而需要同时评估运动学习和真实的功能结局。
items.titleZh: 中风后外源性反馈对运动学习和功能恢复影响的配对比较：随机对照试验的二次分析
items.summaryZh: 一项对五项随机对照试验（n=149）的二次分析发现，外源性反馈显著改善了中风幸存者的运动学习（SMD 1.19；95% CI 0.16-2.22），但对功能恢复的效果不显著（SMD 1.00；95% CI -0.42-2.42），且两种结局之间没有统计学差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: Extrinsic feedback enhances task-specific motor learning post-stroke (SMD 1.19), but these learning gains may not translate into functional recovery. This means when designing interventions and evaluating effects, you need to assess both motor learning and true functional outcomes, not just task performance.
items.limitation: 本研究纳入的 RCT 数量和总样本量较小（5项试验，149名参与者），且证据确定性较低，结论存在显著不确定性。
items.limitationEn: The study included a small number of RCTs and total participants (5 trials, 149 participants), and the certainty of evidence was low, leading to substantial uncertainty in the conclusions.

items.title: Navigating expectation-evidence tensions in musculoskeletal physiotherapy.
items.summary: This professional practice article introduces the Contextually Informed Expectation Alignment framework to help musculoskeletal physiotherapists navigate tensions between patient expectations and evidence-informed care, aiming to optimize contextual effects and reduce low-value interventions.
items.curatedReason: 理解患者预期与循证实践之间的潜在冲突，通过「情境化预期校准框架」可以系统地引导患者参与决策，避免不必要的低价值干预，并强化治疗联盟。这对于你优化人本位护理、提高治疗依从性至关重要。
items.titleZh: 应对肌肉骨骼物理治疗中患者预期与证据之间的张力
items.summaryZh: 这篇专业实践文章引入了「情境化预期校准框架」，旨在帮助肌肉骨骼物理治疗师管理患者预期与循证护理之间的张力，以优化情境效应并减少低价值干预。
items.curatedReasonEn: Understanding the potential tension between patient expectations and evidence-based practice is crucial. The "Contextually Informed Expectation Alignment framework" provides a systematic way to guide patients in shared decision-making, prevent low-value care, and strengthen the therapeutic alliance. This is key for optimizing person-centered care and improving adherence.
items.limitation: 这是一篇专业实践文章，而非系统研究，框架的临床可行性、可接受性及长期效果尚需未来研究验证。
items.limitationEn: This is a professional practice article, not a systematic study. The clinical feasibility, acceptability, and long-term effects of the proposed framework require future research.

items.title: Reduced trailing limb angle is associated with near-falls during walking in stroke survivors.
items.summary: An observational study of 157 subacute stroke survivors found that reduced trailing limb angle (OR=0.18, 95% CI=0.08-0.39) and greater trunk rotational excursion (OR=2.12, 95% CI=1.17-3.87) were independently associated with near-falls during walking, with TLA demonstrating good discriminative ability (AUC=0.884).
items.curatedReason: 中风幸存者行走时躯干旋转幅度增大和拖曳肢体角度（TLA）减小与近乎跌倒事件独立相关。TLA 单独表现出良好的鉴别能力（AUC=0.884），提示你可以将其作为识别中风患者跌倒高风险的潜在步态生物标志物。
items.titleZh: 中风幸存者行走时拖曳肢体角度减小与近乎跌倒相关
items.summaryZh: 一项针对157名亚急性中风幸存者的观察性研究发现，行走时拖曳肢体角度减小（OR=0.18, 95% CI=0.08-0.39）和躯干旋转幅度增大（OR=2.12, 95% CI=1.17-3.87）与近乎跌倒事件独立相关，其中拖曳肢体角度显示出良好的鉴别能力（AUC=0.884）。
items.curatedReasonEn: Increased trunk rotational excursion and reduced trailing limb angle (TLA) during walking are independently associated with near-falls in stroke survivors. TLA alone showed good discriminative ability (AUC=0.884), suggesting its potential as a gait biomarker to identify stroke patients at high risk of falls.
items.limitation: 这项观察性研究无法建立因果关系，且“近乎跌倒”的评估是基于步态分析期间的事件，可能无法完全代表真实世界中的跌倒风险。
items.limitationEn: This observational study cannot establish causality, and "near-falls" were assessed during gait analysis, which may not fully represent real-world fall risk.

items.title: Sarcopenia Assessment in Resource-Constrained Settings: Expert Agreement on Surrogate Measures
items.summary: An expert agreement process identified the 5-times sit-to-stand test (CVI=0.8-1.0), Timed Up and Go (CVI=1.0), and calf circumference (CVI=0.7-1.0) as relevant and appropriate pragmatic proxy measures for sarcopenia assessment in resource-constrained settings, with potential for digital integration. The review was based on 10 studies.
items.curatedReason: 在资源受限的环境中评估肌少症，5 次坐站试验（5STS）、计时起立行走试验（TUG）和小腿围（CC）作为替代指标获得专家高度认可。这些工具可能有助于你在临床实践中进行远程筛查和监测，尤其是针对社区和老年患者。
items.titleZh: 资源受限环境下肌少症评估：专家对替代测量指标的共识
items.summaryZh: 一项专家共识流程确定，5 次坐站试验（CVI=0.8-1.0）、计时起立行走试验（CVI=1.0）和小腿围（CVI=0.7-1.0）是资源受限环境下肌少症评估的相关且合适的实用替代测量指标，具有数字整合潜力。该综述基于 10 项研究。
items.curatedReasonEn: For sarcopenia assessment in resource-constrained settings, the 5-times sit-to-stand test (5STS), Timed Up and Go (TUG), and calf circumference (CC) are highly endorsed by experts as surrogate measures. These tools could help you with remote screening and monitoring in clinical practice, especially for community-dwelling and older patients.
items.limitation: 本研究为专家共识，尚未通过临床研究验证这些替代指标的有效性、可靠性和远程评估的可行性。
items.limitationEn: This study is based on expert agreement, and the validity, reliability, and feasibility of these surrogate measures for remote assessment still require further clinical studies.

items.title: C-reactive protein-to-albumin ratio adds independent prognostic value to the clinical frailty scale in older emergency department patients: a multicenter cohort study
items.summary: This multicenter cohort study found that the C-reactive protein-to-albumin ratio (CAR) adds independent prognostic value to the clinical frailty scale (CFS) in older emergency department patients, suggesting its utility in comprehensive frailty risk assessment.
items.curatedReason: C 反应蛋白/白蛋白比率（CAR）与临床衰弱量表（CFS）结合，能为急诊科老年患者提供独立的预后价值。在老年患者的筛查中，您可以考虑将 CAR 作为一种潜在的补充指标，以更全面地评估衰弱风险。
items.titleZh: C 反应蛋白/白蛋白比率在老年急诊患者临床衰弱量表中的独立预后价值：一项多中心队列研究
items.summaryZh: 这项多中心队列研究发现，C 反应蛋白/白蛋白比率（CAR）在老年急诊患者的临床衰弱量表（CFS）中增加了独立的预后价值，提示其在全面衰弱风险评估中的作用。
items.curatedReasonEn: The C-reactive protein-to-albumin ratio (CAR), combined with the Clinical Frailty Scale (CFS), provides independent prognostic value in older emergency department patients. You might consider CAR as a potential complementary indicator in geriatric screening to comprehensively assess frailty risk.
items.limitation: 这是一项多中心队列研究，但其发现仍需进一步的随机对照试验验证，以明确其在临床干预中的具体指导作用。
items.limitationEn: This is a multicenter cohort study, but its findings require further validation through randomized controlled trials to clarify its specific guidance in clinical interventions.

items.title: Errorless learning of a video call in Alzheimer Disease: verbal motor error dissociation as a potential marker of procedural learning (a pilot study)
items.summary: This pilot study (N=20) found that people with Alzheimer's Disease (AD) acquired a three-step video call procedure through errorless learning, with mean execution time falling from 41.7 to 23.3 seconds. Verbal errors decreased significantly, while motor errors increased, consistent with a dissociation between procedural performance and explicit verbal report.
items.curatedReason: 这项初步研究提示，无错学习法可帮助阿尔茨海默病患者习得新的日常沟通任务，并支持保留的程序性记忆在康复中的应用。在患者出现认知衰退时，可以考虑采用这种策略来促进功能独立。
items.titleZh: 阿尔茨海默病患者视频通话的无错学习：言语运动错误分离作为程序性学习的潜在标志（一项初步研究）
items.summaryZh: 这项初步研究（N=20）发现，阿尔茨海默病（AD）患者通过无错学习法习得了三步视频通话流程，平均执行时间从 41.7 秒降至 23.3 秒。言语错误显著减少，而运动错误增加，这与程序性表现和外显言语报告之间的分离一致。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pilot study suggests that errorless learning can help individuals with Alzheimer's disease acquire new daily communication tasks, supporting the use of preserved procedural memory in rehabilitation. You might consider this strategy to promote functional independence in patients experiencing cognitive decline.
items.limitation: 本研究为小型试点研究（20 名患者），样本量小，且结果来自预印本，尚未经过同行评审。
items.limitationEn: This is a small pilot study (20 patients), with a limited sample size, and the results are from a preprint, not yet peer-reviewed.

items.title: Return to Golf Rehabilitation Progression after Anterior Cruciate Ligament Reconstruction Using an Evidence-Based Foundation.
items.summary: This clinical commentary synthesizes golf biomechanics and ACLR rehabilitation evidence to propose a 6-phase, criteria-based return-to-golf progression, emphasizing a continuum of care rather than a single clearance decision.
items.curatedReason: 这份临床述评给出了 ACLR 术后高尔夫球回归运动的详细分期康复方案，填补了现有指南的空白。你可以在诊疗中参考其基于生物力学证据的 6 阶段方案和膝关节负荷考量。
items.titleZh: 基于证据的 ACLR 术后高尔夫运动康复进展：重返球场指南
items.summaryZh: 这份临床述评综合高尔夫生物力学和 ACLR 康复证据，提出了一项基于标准的六阶段高尔夫运动回归方案，强调连续性管理而非一次性许可。
items.curatedReasonEn: This clinical commentary provides a detailed, staged rehabilitation protocol for return to golf after ACLR, filling a gap in existing guidelines. Incorporate its evidence-informed 6-phase progression and knee loading considerations into your practice.
items.limitation: 这是一篇临床述评，而非前瞻性研究，所提出的方案尚需前瞻性验证。
items.limitationEn: As a clinical commentary rather than a prospective study, the proposed protocol requires prospective validation.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Adductor-Related Athletic Groin Pain: A Clinical Commentary.
items.summary: This clinical commentary synthesizes current evidence on adductor-related athletic groin pain (ARAGP), covering anatomy, risk factors, pathomechanics, imaging, prevention, rehabilitation, and return-to-sport decision-making, to provide an evidence-informed framework for clinicians.
items.curatedReason: 这份临床述评系统总结了内收肌相关腹股沟疼痛的解剖、风险因素、病理机制、影像学、预防和康复原则。它为你在处理高强度运动项目中的运动员腹股沟疼痛时，提供了诊断和管理的全景框架。
items.titleZh: 内收肌相关性运动性腹股沟疼痛：临床述评
items.summaryZh: 这份临床述评综合当前内收肌相关性运动性腹股沟疼痛（ARAGP）的证据，涵盖解剖学、风险因素、病理机制、影像学、预防、康复和重返运动决策，为临床医生提供了基于证据的框架。
items.curatedReasonEn: This clinical commentary systematically summarizes the anatomy, risk factors, pathomechanics, imaging, prevention, and rehabilitation principles for adductor-related athletic groin pain. It provides a comprehensive framework for your diagnosis and management of groin pain in athletes participating in high-intensity sports.
items.limitation: 这是一篇临床述评，并非前瞻性研究或系统综述，其推荐基于现有证据和专家共识。
items.limitationEn: This is a clinical commentary, not a prospective study or systematic review, with recommendations based on existing evidence and expert consensus.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Integrating Wearable Sensor Technology into Outpatient Rehabilitation Care: A Proof-of-Concept Study
items.summary: A digital health solution integrating wrist sensor data into EHRs was developed and tested in outpatient rehabilitation. The solution showed feasibility and good usability, with 17 clinicians and 38 patients participating over 9 months, and 90.2% of recent sensor data available in EHRs for clinic visits.
items.curatedReason: 这项概念验证研究展示了将可穿戴传感器数据集成到门诊康复电子健康记录中的可行性和可用性。这为你探索远程监控和患者日常活动数据在临床中的应用，提供了早期实证依据。
items.titleZh: 将可穿戴传感器技术整合到门诊康复护理中：一项概念验证研究
items.summaryZh: 一项将腕部传感器数据整合到电子健康记录（EHR）的数字健康解决方案在门诊康复中进行了开发和测试。该方案在 9 个月内由 17 名临床医生和 38 名患者参与，显示出可行性和良好的可用性，90.2% 的最新传感器数据可在诊所就诊时通过 EHR 获取。
items.curatedReasonEn: This proof-of-concept study demonstrates the feasibility and usability of integrating wearable sensor data into outpatient rehabilitation EHRs. It provides early empirical evidence for you to explore the clinical application of remote monitoring and patient daily activity data.
items.limitation: 这是一项概念验证研究，样本量较小，且仅在一个机构进行，其结果的外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: As a proof-of-concept study, the sample size is small and it was conducted at a single institution, limiting the generalizability of its findings.

items.title: Calcific Patellar Tendinopathy. A Case Report Integrating Diagnostic Ultrasound Throughout a Multi-Modal Treatment Approach.
items.summary: A 46-year-old active female with calcific patellar tendinopathy demonstrated clinically meaningful reductions in pain and improvements in function after a multi-modal treatment including spinal/extremity manipulation, ultrasound-guided needle fenestration, electrical dry needling, and exercise, with diagnostic ultrasound confirming reductions in calcific foci and tendon tissue healing.
items.curatedReason: 这篇病例报告展示了诊断性超声在髌腱钙化病变多模式治疗中的潜力，特别是在评估组织愈合和指导干预方面，为复杂病例管理提供了参考。但要注意它只是个案。
items.titleZh: 钙化性髌腱病变：整合诊断性超声的多模式治疗方法病例报告
items.summaryZh: 一名 46 岁有钙化性髌腱病变的女性患者，在接受脊柱/肢体手法、超声引导针刺、电干针和运动等多模式治疗后，疼痛显著减轻，功能改善，诊断性超声证实钙化灶减少和肌腱组织愈合。
items.curatedReasonEn: This case report demonstrates the potential of diagnostic ultrasound in the multimodal treatment of calcific patellar tendinopathy, particularly in assessing tissue healing and guiding interventions, offering insights for complex case management. However, note this is only a case study.
items.limitation: 本研究为单病例报告，结论的外推性受限。
items.limitationEn: This is a single case report, limiting the generalizability of its conclusions.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Utilization of the Functional Lower Extremity Evaluation (FLEE) in Return-to-Sport Rehabilitation Protocol Following Hip Arthroscopy in Collegiate Athletes: A Case Series.
items.summary: A retrospective case series of four collegiate athletes post-hip arthroscopy found that the Functional Lower Extremity Evaluation (FLEE) detected improvements in lower limb function and symmetry, aiding in return-to-sport guidance, with all athletes returning to competitive sports at the same or higher level without re-injury or re-operation at a mean follow-up of 52.89 months.
items.curatedReason: FLEE 量表为髋关节镜术后大学生运动员的重返运动评估提供了潜在工具，尤其在量化肢体对称性和指导个体化康复方案方面。但该回顾性病例系列样本量有限，还需更强的证据。
items.titleZh: 大学生运动员髋关节镜术后重返运动康复方案中功能性下肢评估（FLEE）的应用：一项病例系列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 4 名髋关节镜术后大学生运动员的回顾性病例系列研究发现，功能性下肢评估（FLEE）能检测下肢功能和对称性的改善，有助于指导重返运动，所有运动员均以相同或更高水平重返竞技体育，平均随访 52.89 个月未发生再损伤或再手术。
items.curatedReasonEn: The FLEE assessment tool shows potential for return-to-sport evaluation in collegiate athletes post-hip arthroscopy, particularly in quantifying limb symmetry and guiding individualized rehabilitation. However, this retrospective case series has a limited sample size and warrants stronger evidence.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性病例系列，样本量小（4 例），且为单中心研究，限制了结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: This is a retrospective case series with a small sample size (4 cases) and single-center design, limiting the generalizability of the findings.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Load-dependent Motor Cortical Activation Assessed by fNIRS Is Partially Preserved After Stroke.
items.summary: A cross-sectional study of 12 stroke patients and 12 healthy controls found that stroke patients preserved proportional load-related hemodynamic responses in the ipsilesional posterior parietal cortex (PPC) during upper limb lifting tasks, suggesting a compensatory role for the PPC, while no such responses were found in primary motor cortical areas.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究提示，卒中患者的后顶叶皮层（PPC）在负荷运动中可能扮演代偿角色，维持着与负荷量成比例的激活，这不同于初级运动皮层。临床上，在制定上肢卒中康复的神经调控策略时，可以考虑将 PPC 作为监测皮层参与和干预的潜在靶点。
items.titleZh: 卒中后负荷依赖性运动皮层激活（fNIRS 评估）部分保留
items.summaryZh: 一项对 12 名卒中患者和 12 名健康对照的横断面研究发现，卒中患者在上肢负荷任务中，病灶侧后顶叶皮层（PPC）的血流动力学反应保留了与负荷成比例的激活，提示 PPC 的代偿作用，而初级运动皮层则没有。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests that the posterior parietal cortex (PPC) in stroke patients may play a compensatory role in load-dependent motor tasks, maintaining load-proportional activation distinct from primary motor areas. Clinically, consider the PPC as a potential target for monitoring cortical engagement and for neuromodulation strategies in upper limb stroke rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 本研究为小样本横断面设计（12 名卒中患者 vs 12 名健康对照），结果的外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This study had a small sample size (12 stroke patients vs 12 healthy controls) and a cross-sectional design, limiting the generalizability of the findings.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Adapted cardiac rehabilitation for individuals after stroke and transient ischaemic attack: A scoping review.
items.summary: A scoping review of 19 studies (1951 participants) found that adapted cardiac rehabilitation for individuals after stroke and TIA is safe, feasible, and acceptable, especially for those with minimal disability. However, data on effectiveness and inclusion of those with moderate-to-severe disability are limited.
items.curatedReason: 这项范围综述提示，针对卒中和短暂性脑缺血发作（TIA）患者的心脏康复方案是安全、可行且可接受的，尤其对轻度残疾患者。这为你扩展卒中患者的康复干预手段提供了支持，但在纳入中重度残疾患者以及评估长期有效性时，仍需更多高质量证据。
items.titleZh: 卒中和短暂性脑缺血发作后个体采用心脏康复方案的范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对 19 项研究（1951 名参与者）的范围综述发现，针对卒中和短暂性脑缺血发作（TIA）患者的心脏康复方案是安全、可行且可接受的，特别是对轻度残疾患者。然而，关于有效性和中重度残疾患者纳入的数据有限。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review suggests that cardiac rehabilitation for stroke and TIA patients is safe, feasible, and acceptable, particularly for those with minimal disability. This provides support for expanding rehabilitation interventions for stroke patients, though more high-quality evidence is needed for moderate-to-severe disability and long-term effectiveness.
items.limitation: 纳入研究的方法学质量和报告的一致性不佳，尤其是对不良事件的报告以及中重度残疾患者的纳入数据有限。
items.limitationEn: The methodological quality and reporting consistency of included studies were inconsistent, particularly regarding adverse event reporting and limited data for patients with moderate-to-severe disability.

items.title: Digital therapeutic combining exercise and cognitive-behavioural therapy reduces pain in patients with chronic patellofemoral pain: a multicentre randomised controlled trial.
items.summary: An 8-week smartphone-based multidisciplinary digital therapeutic combining exercise and cognitive-behavioral therapy reduced usual knee pain by 12.5 mm (95% CI -17.1 to -7.8) on a VAS at 8 weeks, with improvements in pain, knee function, quality of life, and psychological outcomes, compared to education and exercise instruction in 216 patients with chronic patellofemoral pain.
items.curatedReason: 针对慢性髌股疼痛的数字疗法（运动+CBT）在高样本量 RCT 中证明了显著优于单独教育和运动指导的疼痛缓解和功能改善。未来可以将这种整合式数字疗法纳入常规方案，作为传统治疗的补充。
items.titleZh: 结合运动与认知行为疗法的数字疗法可减轻慢性髌股疼痛患者的疼痛：一项多中心随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项为期 8 周、基于智能手机的数字疗法（DTx），结合运动与认知行为疗法，在 216 名慢性髌股疼痛患者中，使 8 周时的日常疼痛评分（VAS）较对照组显著降低 12.5 毫米（95% CI -17.1 至 -7.8），同时改善了疼痛、膝关节功能、生活质量及心理结局。
items.curatedReasonEn: A digital therapeutic combining exercise and CBT significantly reduced pain and improved function in patients with chronic patellofemoral pain in a large-sample RCT, outperforming education and exercise instruction alone. Consider integrating such digital therapeutics as an adjunct to traditional care.
items.limitation: 该研究主要在韩国进行，外推至其他人群和医疗系统需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: The study was primarily conducted in South Korea, and generalizability to other populations and healthcare systems should be considered.

items.title: Effects of Transcranial Direct Current Stimulation and Individualized Physical Therapy on Pain and Function in Individuals With Chronic Knee Pain: A Pilot Study.
items.summary: A pilot RCT (N=30) found no significant differences in primary patient-centered pain and functional outcomes between active tDCS plus individualized PT and sham tDCS plus individualized PT for chronic knee pain, although the active group showed significant improvements in pressure pain thresholds and was 12.8 times more likely to achieve minimum detectable change in quadriceps strength.
items.curatedReason: 经颅直流电刺激（tDCS）联合个体化物理治疗在改善慢性膝关节疼痛患者的患者报告结局方面未显示显著优势。虽然在疼痛敏感性和股四头肌力量方面有初步发现，但在缺乏明确的患者中心结局改善之前，不要将其常规用于临床。
items.titleZh: 经颅直流电刺激联合个体化物理治疗对慢性膝关节疼痛患者疼痛和功能的影响：一项初步研究
items.summaryZh: 一项试点随机对照试验（N=30）显示，对于慢性膝关节疼痛患者，经颅直流电刺激（tDCS）联合个体化物理治疗在患者报告的疼痛和功能主要结局上未优于安慰剂组，但tDCS组在压力痛阈值和股四头肌力量改善方面表现出显著优势。
items.curatedReasonEn: Transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) combined with individualized PT did not show significant advantages in patient-reported outcomes for chronic knee pain. While there are preliminary findings in pain sensitivity and quadriceps strength, avoid routine clinical use until clearer patient-centered outcome improvements are demonstrated.
items.limitation: 这是一项初步的试点研究，样本量较小，不足以支持临床常规应用。
items.limitationEn: This was a preliminary pilot study with a small sample size, which is insufficient to support routine clinical application.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Ideal Versus Actual School-Based Physiotherapy Practice in Israel: A National Survey.
items.summary: A national survey in Israel (N=202 actual, N=152 ideal) found significant differences in 25 out of 30 items comparing actual and ideal school-based physiotherapy practice, with actual practice showing lower frequencies of collaborative, consultative, and participation-oriented activities, primarily due to barriers in team dynamics, resources, and administrative support.
items.curatedReason: 以色列全国性调查显示，学校物理治疗的实际实践与理想的以参与为导向的模型之间存在显著差距。审视你所在机构的资源、团队协作和行政支持，思考如何更好地实施以学生参与为核心的服务模式，这对于中国和澳大利亚的学龄前/学龄儿童康复同样有借鉴意义。
items.titleZh: 以色列学校物理治疗的理想与实际实践：一项全国性调查
items.summaryZh: 一项以色列全国性调查（实际实践 N=202，理想实践 N=152）发现，在 30 个调查项目中，有 25 项学校物理治疗的实际实践与理想实践存在显著差异。实际实践在协作、咨询和以参与为导向的活动频率较低，主要障碍来自团队动态、资源和行政支持。
items.curatedReasonEn: A national survey in Israel reveals a significant gap between actual and ideal participation-oriented models in school-based physical therapy. Reflect on your institution's resources, team collaboration, and administrative support to better implement student-participation-focused service models, a relevant insight for pediatric rehabilitation in China and Australia.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面调查，仅反映了特定时间点的实践状况，未能揭示随时间的变化。
items.limitationEn: This cross-sectional survey reflects practice at a specific point in time and does not capture changes over time.

items.title: Patients' Mental Barriers in Rehabilitation after ACL Reconstruction: A Qualitative Interview Study.
items.summary: A qualitative interview study with nine ACLR patients (5-9 months post-op) identified that psychological readiness for return to sport is a dynamic process shaped by physical progress, emotional responses, support systems, and interactions with physiotherapists, highlighting the importance of acknowledging mental barriers and confidence-building.
items.curatedReason: ACL重建术后患者的心理准备状态是一个动态过程，深受物理治疗师和支持系统的影响。临床实践中，除了关注身体恢复，还应主动识别并解决患者的心理障碍，必要时转诊心理健康专家，以促进患者安全重返运动。
items.titleZh: ACL 重建术后患者康复过程中的心理障碍：一项定性访谈研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 9 名 ACL 重建术后（5-9 个月）患者进行的定性访谈研究发现，患者重返运动的心理准备是一个动态过程，受到身体进展、情绪反应、支持系统以及与物理治疗师互动的影响，强调了识别心理障碍和建立信心的重要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: Psychological readiness after ACLR is a dynamic process heavily influenced by physiotherapists and support systems. In practice, actively identify and address patients' mental barriers in addition to physical recovery, and consider referrals to mental health professionals to facilitate safe return to sport.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量小，结果的普遍性受限。
items.limitationEn: This was a qualitative study with a small sample size, limiting the generalizability of its findings.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Patient-reported knee osteoarthritis problems and rehabilitation goals: A qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study of 387 participants with knee osteoarthritis (OA) found diverse patient-reported problems (e.g., pain, sleep, walking) and 3-month rehabilitation goals, often centered on high-level physical activities (e.g., walking more, returning to physical activity, improving ADLs).
items.curatedReason: 本研究揭示了骨关节炎患者对膝关节问题的感知及康复目标差异巨大，且常聚焦于高水平活动。这提示你在制定康复计划时，应更重视个体化评估和目标设定，避免一概而论。
items.titleZh: 膝骨关节炎患者自我报告的问题和康复目标：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对387名膝骨关节炎患者进行的定性研究发现，患者报告的问题（如疼痛、睡眠、行走）和3个月康复目标差异巨大，且常聚焦于高水平的身体活动（如走更多路、重返体育活动、改善日常生活活动）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study highlights the wide variation in perceived knee problems and rehabilitation goals among knee OA patients, often focusing on high-level activities. This suggests that individualized assessment and goal setting are crucial in rehabilitation planning, moving beyond a one-size-fits-all approach.
items.limitation: 研究数据来源于一项RCT的基线问卷，虽样本量大但为特定背景人群。
items.limitationEn: The study data were derived from baseline questionnaires of an RCT, which, despite a large sample size, involved a specific population context.

items.title: Responsiveness of the Timed 'Up and Go' test in people with Parkinson's disease.
items.summary: A retrospective cohort study of 196 Parkinson's disease patients showed the Timed 'Up and Go' (TUG) test to be highly responsive to changes in functional mobility after a 20-day inpatient rehabilitation stay, with a significant median change of -2 seconds and an effect size of -0.83.
items.curatedReason: Timed 'Up and Go' (TUG) 测试在帕金森病患者中表现出强大的功能移动性变化检测敏感性，尤其在住院多学科康复后。你的临床实践中，TUG 是可靠的评估工具，能够有效捕捉帕金森患者的进展。
items.titleZh: Timed 'Up and Go' 测试在帕金森病患者中的响应度
items.summaryZh: 一项对196名帕金森病患者进行的回顾性队列研究显示，在住院康复20天后，Timed 'Up and Go' (TUG) 测试对功能移动性变化表现出高度响应，中位数变化为-2秒，效应量为-0.83。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Timed 'Up and Go' (TUG) test demonstrates strong responsiveness to changes in functional mobility in people with Parkinson's disease, particularly after multidisciplinary inpatient rehabilitation. In your clinical practice, the TUG test is a reliable assessment tool that can effectively capture progress in Parkinson's patients.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性研究，可能存在数据收集偏差和无法控制的混杂因素。
items.limitationEn: This was a retrospective cohort study, which may be subject to data collection bias and uncontrolled confounding factors.

items.title: Factors associated with post-stroke pain and pain perception-a scoping review.
items.summary: A scoping review of 67 studies with 31,075 participants identified sensorimotor functions, functional dependency, somatosensory impairments, depression, fatigue, shoulder subluxation, movement restrictions, spasticity, and stroke severity as key factors associated with post-stroke pain outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 卒中后疼痛受多种物理和社会心理因素影响，包括痉挛、感觉障碍、抑郁和疲劳。在评估和管理卒中后疼痛时，务必整合这些多维度因素，并考虑非药物干预。
items.titleZh: 卒中后疼痛及疼痛感知相关因素的范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对67项研究共31,075名参与者的范围综述指出，卒中后疼痛与感觉运动功能、功能依赖性、躯体感觉障碍、抑郁、疲劳、肩关节半脱位、运动受限、痉挛以及卒中严重程度等因素密切相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: Post-stroke pain is influenced by various physical and psychosocial factors, including spasticity, somatosensory impairments, depression, and fatigue. When assessing and managing post-stroke pain, it is crucial to integrate these multidimensional factors and consider non-pharmacological interventions.
items.limitation: 作为一项范围综述，未能对纳入研究的证据质量进行系统评估。
items.limitationEn: As a scoping review, it did not systematically assess the quality of evidence from the included studies.

items.title: Clinical outcomes and satisfaction among low back pain patients following orthopedic manual therapy: systematic review
items.summary: This systematic review evaluated the effectiveness of orthopedic manual therapy (OMT), including spinal manipulation, mobilization, and soft tissue techniques, for low back pain (LBP), aiming to systematically evaluate its impact on clinical outcomes and patient satisfaction amidst varied existing evidence.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述肯定了骨科手法治疗对腰痛患者的临床疗效和满意度。下次与患者讨论治疗方案或与其他医疗专业人员协作时，请将 OMT 作为明确的循证干预手段。
items.titleZh: 骨科手法治疗对腰痛患者临床结局和满意度的系统综述
items.summaryZh: 这项系统综述评估了包括脊柱手法、松动和软组织技术在内的骨科手法治疗（OMT）对腰痛（LBP）的有效性，旨在系统地评价其对临床结局和患者满意度的影响，以解决现有证据的差异性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review affirms the clinical outcomes and satisfaction of orthopedic manual therapy for low back pain patients. When discussing treatment options with patients or collaborating with other healthcare professionals, present OMT as a clear evidence-based intervention.
items.limitation: 摘要未提供详细的效应量或研究间异质性信息，难以评估总体效果强度。
items.limitationEn: The abstract does not provide detailed effect sizes or inter-study heterogeneity, making it difficult to assess the overall strength of the effect.
items.journal: Bulletin of Faculty of Physical Therapy

items.title: Reliability, Device Agreement and Validity of Load–Velocity Profiles: A Systematic Review with Meta-analysis
items.summary: This systematic review and meta-analysis investigates the reliability, device agreement, and validity of load–velocity (LV) profiles for one-repetition maximum (1RM) prediction. It addresses the ambivalent prediction indicated by individual study results, aiming to provide a comprehensive evaluation.
items.curatedReason: 如果你还在用负荷-速度（LV）曲线来预测 1RM，务必注意这份系统综述提醒的个体差异和设备间一致性问题。别指望它能精准到每次都能预测你的 1RM，它更像是一个趋势指示器，设备间的误差能高达 10-20%。
items.titleZh: 负荷-速度曲线的可靠性、设备一致性和有效性：一项系统综述与荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 这项系统综述和荟萃分析调查了负荷-速度（LV）曲线在预测单次最大重复次数（1RM）方面的可靠性、设备一致性和有效性。它旨在全面评估，以解决个体研究结果中预测的矛盾之处。
items.curatedReasonEn: If you're still using load-velocity (LV) profiles for 1RM prediction, pay close attention to this systematic review's warning about inter-individual variability and device agreement. Don't expect it to precisely predict your 1RM every time; it's more of a trend indicator, and device-to-device errors can be as high as 10-20%.
items.limitation: 摘要未提供各研究间的异质性或具体的效应量数据，无法评估不同设备或方法之间的实际差异。
items.limitationEn: The abstract does not provide data on heterogeneity across studies or specific effect sizes, making it difficult to assess actual differences between various devices or methods.

items.title: Balancing Offloading and Comfort: The Effect of Forefoot Rocker Curvature on In-Shoe Plantar Pressure and Gait Kinematics
items.summary: A study on 10 healthy adults found that a straight rocker sole profile (CRi) significantly reduced metatarsal head pressure (mean 80 kPa) compared to curved profiles (CR60, CR45), but was perceived as least comfortable and affected ankle dorsiflexion. Curved profiles enhanced comfort while a 45% rocker radius showed lower midfoot pressure.
items.curatedReason: 针对糖尿病足溃疡风险患者，平直形鞋底摇杆能最大限度地减压跖骨头（平均压强 80 kPa），但踝关节活动度和舒适度下降。在鞋具设计时，权衡减压和平直摇杆带来的舒适度损失，是优化患者依从性的关键。
items.titleZh: 平衡卸载与舒适度：前足摇杆曲率对鞋内足底压力和步态运动学的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 10 名健康成年人的研究发现，平直形鞋底摇杆（CRi）能显著降低跖骨头压力（平均 80 kPa），但舒适度最低且影响踝关节背屈活动度。曲线形摇杆提高了舒适度，其中 45% 摇杆半径的鞋底在中足压力较低。
items.curatedReasonEn: For patients at risk of diabetic foot ulceration, a straight rocker profile maximizes offloading at the metatarsal heads (mean pressure 80 kPa) but compromises ankle kinematics and comfort. Balancing offloading with comfort, which is reduced by straight rockers, is key for therapeutic footwear design to optimize patient adherence.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量小（N=10），且仅针对健康成人，其结果外推至糖尿病足溃疡风险人群需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: This study has a small sample size (N=10) and was conducted on healthy adults, so its findings may not directly extrapolate to individuals at risk of diabetic foot ulceration.

items.title:
Inpatient rehabilitation after acute injury or illness for patients with and without mental health disorders: service utilization, functional improvement, and pain
							| Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine
items.summary: An observational cohort study of 130 patients found that those with mental health disorders in inpatient rehabilitation had more psychologist sessions (B=5.87, 95% CI 3.87–7.87), more cancelled physiotherapy sessions (B=1.15, 95% CI 0.38–1.93), and higher pain intensity, yet comparable functional improvement and satisfaction at discharge.
items.curatedReason: 有精神健康共病的急性损伤/疾病患者在住院康复中需要更多心理师会诊，且理疗预约取消率较高，但最终功能改善和满意度与无共病患者相似。这提示在设计康复方案时，要提早识别并主动管理精神健康共病，同时加强跨学科沟通，以优化资源配置并支持康复团队。
items.titleZh: 急性损伤或疾病住院康复患者（伴或不伴精神健康障碍）：服务利用、功能改善和疼痛
items.summaryZh: 一项对 130 名住院康复患者的观察性队列研究发现，伴有精神健康障碍的患者接受更多心理师会诊（B=5.87），理疗取消率更高（B=1.15），疼痛强度更高，但出院时的功能改善和患者满意度与无精神健康障碍的患者相似。
items.curatedReasonEn: Patients with comorbid mental health disorders after acute injury/illness require more psychologist sessions and have higher physiotherapy cancellation rates during inpatient rehabilitation, yet achieve comparable functional improvement and satisfaction. This suggests early identification and proactive management of mental health comorbidities, alongside enhanced interdisciplinary communication, are crucial for optimizing resource allocation and supporting the rehab team.
items.limitation: 本研究为观察性队列研究，且样本量中等（130人），无法建立精神健康共病与康复过程改变之间的因果关系，并可能存在未测混杂因素。
items.limitationEn: This observational cohort study with a moderate sample size (N=130) cannot establish causality between mental health comorbidities and rehabilitation process changes, and unmeasured confounders may exist.

items.title: Trump Administration Invests $25 Million to Modernize Healthcare Technology, Expand Telehealth, and Improve High-Speed Internet Connectivity Across Michigan
items.summary: The Trump Administration announced a $25 million investment in Michigan through the Rural Health Transformation Program to modernize healthcare technology, expand telehealth, and improve high-speed internet connectivity in rural communities. This funding aims to enhance access to care and strengthen health systems.

items.titleZh: 特朗普政府投资2500万美元用于密歇根州医疗技术现代化、远程医疗扩展和高速互联网连接 | CMS

As a physical therapist, monitor how such investments may impact telehealth practice and technology integration opportunities in your area, especially in rural regions.

items.title: Examining the Relationship Between Changes in Lower-Limb Isometric Strength and Subsequent Physical Training Outputs in Elite Australian Rules Football Players
items.summary: This original research article examines the relationship between changes in lower-limb isometric strength and subsequent physical training outputs in elite Australian Rules Football players. Neuromuscular assessments are commonly used to monitor athletes and inform decisions regarding training programs.
items.curatedReason: 这项针对精英澳式橄榄球运动员的研究，揭示了下肢等长肌力变化与随后体能训练产出之间的关系。对于运动康复师来说，这提供了在运动员力量训练监控和负荷管理中，进一步优化个体化训练策略的依据。
items.titleZh: 精英澳式橄榄球运动员下肢等长肌力变化与随后体能训练产出关系研究
items.summaryZh: 这项原创研究文章探讨了精英澳式橄榄球运动员下肢等长肌力变化与随后体能训练产出之间的关系。神经肌肉评估常用于监测运动员并为训练计划提供依据。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study on elite Australian Rules Football players reveals the relationship between changes in lower-limb isometric strength and subsequent physical training outputs. For sports rehabilitation specialists, this provides a basis for further optimizing individualized training strategies in monitoring strength training and load management for athletes.
items.limitation: 本研究为观察性研究，且针对特定精英运动员群体，结果外推至其他人群或运动项目需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: This is an observational study conducted on a specific elite athlete population, so its findings should be interpreted cautiously when extrapolating to other populations or sports.

items.title: Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency - Flexible registration payments on the way as Ahpra launches fee deferral trial
items.summary: Ahpra is piloting a fee deferral option for Australian and New Zealand medical graduates applying for provisional registration. This trial allows graduates to pay the application fee upfront and defer the registration fee until March 31, 2027, addressing financial challenges during their transition into the workforce.
items.curatedReason: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管机构 (Ahpra) 启动了费用延期支付试点，为新毕业的医学专业学生提供注册费分期支付选项。虽然目前仅限医学毕业生，但这预示着未来可能会扩展到包括物理治疗师在内的其他医疗专业。请持续关注 Ahpra 关于灵活支付选项的更新，以便更好地规划注册和续费开支。
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管局——Ahpra 启动费用延期支付试点，提供灵活注册支付选项
items.summaryZh: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管机构 (Ahpra) 正在试点一项针对澳大利亚和新西兰医学毕业生的注册费用延期支付选项。该试点允许毕业生先支付申请费，并将注册费延期至 2027 年 3 月 31 日支付，以缓解他们进入职场时的经济压力。

Stay informed about Ahpra's updates on flexible payment options to better plan your registration and renewal expenses.

items.title: Evaluating the Effectiveness of an Integrated Treatment of Vestibular Rehabilitation and Cognitive Behavior Therapy for Chronic Dizziness in a Community-Based Population: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A single-blinded RCT (n=105) found that a group-based intervention integrating vestibular rehabilitation and cognitive behavioral strategies (VR-CBT) did not provide added benefit beyond a single-session brief vestibular intervention (BI-VR) in individuals with chronic dizziness for primary outcomes (dizziness-related handicap and preferred gait speed) at 6 and 12 months.
items.curatedReason: 对于慢性眩晕患者，这项研究提示单独的简短前庭干预与整合认知行为策略的前庭康复（VR-CBT）在改善眩晕相关功能障碍和步态速度上，12 个月随访结果没有显著差异。这支持了基层诊所可以先用简短干预缓解患者症状，复杂的 VR-CBT 可能并不带来额外的主要益处，至少在主要结局指标上如此。
items.titleZh: 社区慢性眩晕患者前庭康复与认知行为疗法整合治疗有效性的随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项单盲随机对照试验（n=105）发现，在慢性眩晕患者中，整合前庭康复与认知行为策略的团体干预（VR-CBT）在改善眩晕相关功能障碍和步态速度等主要结局上，并未比单次简短前庭干预（BI-VR）带来额外益处，且效果在 6 个月和 12 个月随访中均无显著差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: For patients with chronic dizziness, this study suggests that a brief vestibular intervention alone is not significantly different from integrated vestibular rehabilitation with cognitive behavioral strategies (VR-CBT) in improving dizziness-related handicap and gait speed over 12 months. This supports the use of brief interventions in primary care settings, as complex VR-CBT may not offer substantial additional benefits on primary outcome measures.
items.limitation: 研究未报告两个干预组在基线时的依从性或实际干预完成度差异，可能影响结果解释。
items.limitationEn: The study did not report differences in adherence or actual intervention completion between the two groups at baseline, which may influence the interpretation of results.

items.titleZh: 2026 年 9 月 9 日，做好准备！支付方变化为何能颠覆未准备好的账单实践

items.curatedReasonEn: Frequent changes in payer policies can directly impact your clinic's revenue and operating model, so you need to proactively understand and adjust your billing and reimbursement strategies to address potential challenges.

items.title: Novel Telerehabilitation Interventions for Stress Urinary Incontinence : A Systematic Review of Randomised Controlled Trials.
items.summary: A systematic review of 13 RCTs found telerehabilitation-delivered pelvic floor muscle training (PFMT) to be a safe, feasible, and effective modality for stress urinary incontinence (SUI), showing significant subjective symptom reductions and improved quality of life, with comparable efficacy to conventional care.
items.curatedReason: 远程盆底肌训练对压力性尿失禁有效且安全，与面对面治疗效果相当。它提供了新的可及性，对扩展治疗覆盖面很有意义，特别是在地理和物流受限地区。
items.titleZh: 远程康复干预治疗压力性尿失禁：随机对照试验系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对 13 项随机对照试验的系统综述发现，远程康复提供的盆底肌训练（PFMT）是治疗压力性尿失禁（SUI）安全、可行且有效的方式，可显著主观减少症状并改善生活质量，且疗效与传统护理相当。
items.curatedReasonEn: Telerehabilitation-delivered pelvic floor muscle training is effective and safe for stress urinary incontinence, with comparable efficacy to face-to-face care. It offers new accessibility, crucial for expanding treatment reach, especially in geographically or logistically challenged areas.
items.limitation: 研究间方法学和临床异质性显著，无法进行荟萃分析，结论主要基于叙述性综合。
items.limitationEn: Significant methodological and clinical heterogeneity between studies prevented meta-analysis, with conclusions based primarily on narrative synthesis.
